# `aitbc gpu unregister`

Unregister or delete a GPU from the local GPU service. Local only: it does not touch the blockchain. To take an on-chain GPU registration out of service, use `aitbc gpu-onchain deregister`.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc gpu unregister [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--gpu-id` | text | — | yes | The Gpu id. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc gpu unregister --gpu-id <gpu_id>
```
